Tina Fransgård is a department physician (afdelingslæge) holding a Ph.D., who plays a key role in the governance of the Danish National Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) [^src1]. She serves as a member of the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]], where she represents Region Sjælland (Region Zealand) [^src1]. Her position on the steering group is significant as it ensures direct regional representation within the database's leadership and decision-making structure [^src1]. The steering group itself functions as the institutional framework for DANIBD's operations, operating as an interdisciplinary and regional body that includes physicians, nursing leaders, patient representatives, and experts from the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme [^src1].
